note: The food corpus is an external release artifact. Content is the authority: sumsSha256 pins the per-file checksum list, and the build verifies every file against it. The archive checksum pins the reproducible archive made by scripts/package.mjs; an earlier archive of identical content stays accepted. The build fetches the archive itself when data/food is missing and FOOD_DATA_URL (or archive.url) is set.

acceptedArchives.note: the first published archive: not reproducible, identical content (the per-file sums match sumsSha256)
